I have farmed this coastal land near Dar es Salaam for many years, and I know the soil is sandy and tired. I will buy a few bags of fertilizer from the agro-dealer when he comes to the market, but I cannot afford much, so it will be about 15 kg of nitrogen for each hectare; I will also put manure from our goats because it costs no cash. I use local seed that I saved myself because improved seed is too expensive for 13 hectares, and I only change what I do after I see my neighbor succeed. My family will work about 160 days on this plot, but we must hire around 380 days of labor for planting and weeding such a big area.
